name: Follow-up email
prompt: Draft a follow-up email to the attendees summarizing decisions, action items with owners and dates, and open questions. Keep it under 200 words.

name: Action items
prompt: List every action item as `- [ ] owner — task (due)` grouped by owner; cite segments.

name: Decisions
prompt: List the decisions made, each with who decided and the rationale; cite segments.

name: Open questions
prompt: List unresolved questions and who should answer them; cite segments.

name: My commitments
prompt: List everything I (Me) committed to do, with any dates mentioned; cite segments.
